summary: Iter819 — Validated three new features: (1) FPS share-join viral counter, (2) Home Dashboard Job Hunt Pulse card, (3) Streak-protection nudge admin trigger. Backend 17/17 PASS in ~2.4s (new test_iter819_share_join_job_pulse_streak_nudge.py). Frontend verified end-to-end via Playwright on both desktop 1920 and mobile 390.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/games_station.py POST /share-join correctly enforces (a) auth via require_auth, (b) 404 for unknown match, (c) own_match short-circuit, (d) idempotency via unique (owner_user_id, joiner_user_id), (e) fps_share_join notification to owner. Response shape {recorded, owner_share_joins|reason} is stable.

backend/routes/job_search.py GET /pulse builds all required fields (profile_complete/status_counts/tracked/new_matching_*/best_fit_*/kits_this_week/apps_this_week). Free-tier users with no job_search_profile get profile_complete=false and zeroed status_counts — correct fail-safe.

backend/routes/gamification.py run_streak_protection_nudge is properly gated (@router.post admin-only) and correctly idempotent via streak_nudge_log unique(user_id,date_key) — verified end-to-end (fresh notify -> notified>=1, immediate re-run -> skipped>=1).
backend/scheduler.py registers streak_protection_nudge via CronTrigger(hour=18, minute=0), max_instances=1, replace_existing=True — good.

frontend /fps-match/[matchId] correctly shows green pill 'N players joined from this card' (only when share_joins > 0), stores localStorage 'fps_share_ref' and navigates to /auth/login on CTA — matches i18n contract, no raw keys.

frontend FPS hub redemption effect: on load, if localStorage 'fps_share_ref' is present -> POST /games-station/share-join -> then clears the key. Verified: single POST fired, key cleared to null after hub load.

frontend Home Dashboard Job Hunt Pulse card renders below Activity Pulse with all 7 required testids (stat-applied/interviews/offers/tracked, matches, week-row, cta). CTA button click navigates to /job-search. Admin expected values match: 5 Applied / 0 Interviews / 0 Offers / 5 Tracked / 72% best fit / 2 kits this week / 5 applications this week.
Mobile 390px width: fps-match public card + share row + pill render with no horizontal overflow; layout stacks cleanly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (public pill, CTA localStorage+redirect, hub redemption+key-clear, home pulse 7/7 testids, mobile no-overflow)
